doc: The main views of the API, as `GET /api/installations`, `/api/devices` and `/api/rooms` give them. `tests/views.rs` checks them against the real answers of the server and writes the web types from them (`web/src/lib/api.generated.ts`). A type is a TypeScript expression; `optional` fields may be absent.

Connection.doc: The link with an installation's WebServer (or its node).

AirQuality.doc: Air quality, for thermostats with a sensor.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: null while the sensor gives no measure.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Value read from the WebServer.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: Air purification.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Name to display (Breezone custom name, else the Airzone name).

fields.name: modes
fields.doc: Modes available on this zone's system.

fields.name: demand
fields.doc: The zone is currently asking for heat or cold.

fields.name: air_quality
fields.doc: Thermostats with an air quality sensor only.

NodeRef.doc: The node an installation is reached through.

InstallationUserRights.doc: What a user may change on an installation, besides driving it.

fields.name: zones
fields.doc: Zone names and groups.

fields.name: schedules
fields.doc: Airzone schedules.

fields.name: admin
fields.doc: The installation's own settings (address, Airzone link, deletion).

Installation.doc: An Airzone installation, with its zones.

fields.name: country
fields.doc: Country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), set by hand.

fields.name: access
fields.doc: "local": WebServer on this server's network; "node": through another Breezone server.

fields.name: controllable
fields.doc: false when read-only (for this user, or shared read-only by its node).

fields.name: rights
fields.doc: What the signed-in user may change on it.

fields.name: record_demand
fields.doc: The time each zone spends in demand is recorded (set on the server that owns it).

Measures.doc: What a "consumption" measure measures: a device, or a room.

DeviceView.doc: A device of the home: an Airzone zone or a device of a module (ADR 0013).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Main trait ("climate.zone").

fields.name: traits
fields.doc: `trait@version` the device has.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Driver that provides it ("airzone", "shelly").

fields.name: reference
fields.doc: Where to find it in its source (Airzone: `{system_id, zone_id}`).

fields.name: available
fields.doc: The source currently provides it (a zone removed from its installation is not).

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Values of its traits (fields described in the catalog).

fields.name: can_control
fields.doc: This user may drive it.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Chosen by hand (a Lucide name); null: guessed from the name.

Contract.doc: The electricity contract of the home (one per server, as its meter).

fields.name: country
fields.doc: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ("FR").

fields.name: offer
fields.doc: "custom": prices set by hand.

fields.name: power_kva
fields.doc: Subscribed power (kVA).

fields.name: currency
fields.doc: ISO 4217 ("EUR").

fields.name: offpeak
fields.doc: The off-peak hours of an "hc" offer read from the CRE (empty: 22:00 to 06:00).

OffPeak.doc: A stretch of off-peak hours, local time; `from` after `to` goes over midnight.

PriceSlot.doc: A slot of a profile of day: from its start until the next one.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: "HH:MM", local time; the first one is "00:00".

fields.name: name
fields.doc: "HP", "HC"…

fields.name: price
fields.doc: Per kWh, taxes included.

DayProfile.doc: The prices of a kind of day ("normal", "red day"…), slot by slot.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Chosen by hand ("#2563eb").

ColorProfiles.doc: The profile a day of an announced colour follows (Tempo).

fields.name: day_start
fields.doc: "HH:MM": when a day of the tariff starts (Tempo: "06:00").

fields.name: weekdays
fields.doc: The profile of each day of the week, Monday first.

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: Instead of the day of the week, when the colour of the day is announced.

Tariff.doc: The prices from a day on.

fields.name: subscription
fields.doc: Per month, taxes included.

fields.name: export_price
fields.doc: Per kWh returned to the grid; null: not sold.

TariffVersion.doc: A tariff and the local day it applies from.

fields.name: valid_from
fields.doc: "YYYY-MM-DD".

TariffView.doc: The contract of the home and its tariffs.

fields.name: contract
fields.doc: null: not set yet.

fields.name: versions
fields.doc: Oldest first.

fields.name: can_edit
fields.doc: This user may change them.

PriceAt.doc: The price at a moment, and where it comes from.

fields.name: price
fields.doc: Per kWh.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: The colour of the day, when the calendar follows one and it is known.

fields.name: day
fields.doc: The day of the tariff ("YYYY-MM-DD"): the day before at night when a day starts at 06:00.

PricePeriod.doc: A stretch of time at one price.

PriceView.doc: The price of electricity now, and over the next hours.

fields.name: now
fields.doc: null: no tariff for now.

fields.name: periods
fields.doc: From now on.

fields.name: tempo
fields.doc: null: no tariff follows the colour of the days.

TempoView.doc: The Tempo days, when a tariff follows their colour.

fields.name: tomorrow
fields.doc: Announced in the morning (null before).

fields.name: red_left
fields.doc: Red days left in the season (1 September to 31 August).

ChargeRuleRef.doc: An automation (or a charger) by its id and name.

fields.name: kw
fields.doc: Up to this power (null: the charger's maximum).

fields.name: automations
fields.doc: The automations that give it to a charger.

ChargeEffect.doc: What an automation tells a charger.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: profile: follow a profile; off: no charge; solar: the solar surplus; free: its own app; now: charge now.

fields.name: kw
fields.doc: now: the power asked (null: the charger's maximum).

ChargeDaySegment.doc: A stretch of a day of a frieze, in minutes from midnight.

fields.name: effect
fields.doc: null: nothing told yet.

ChargeBar.doc: A frieze of an automation for a charger: a day of a kind of the tariff, or any day.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: The kind of day of the tariff it names (null: every day, or the other days).

fields.name: label
fields.doc: The name of the kind of day (empty: every day, or the other days).

fields.name: others
fields.doc: The days of the kinds it does not name.

ChargeRuleSummary.doc: An automation in words, in the language of the request.

ChargeRulePlan.doc: An automation that drives a charger, with its friezes (`GET /api/charging/automations`).

fields.name: devices
fields.doc: The chargers it drives.

fields.name: paused
fields.doc: Every charger it drives lets its own app decide: it does not apply.

fields.name: placed
fields.doc: One of its triggers is at a time (else no frieze).

fields.name: assumed
fields.doc: A condition that cannot be told ahead was taken as true.

fields.name: until
fields.doc: Until then (null: until unplugged, or its energy).

fields.name: kwh
fields.doc: Energy to add.

fields.name: left_kwh
fields.doc: Energy still to add.

ChargeStatus.doc: What the charger does now, as the surplus regulator says.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: solar | guarantee | waiting | no_car | unavailable | no_meter | manual | no_charge | charging | now.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: In words, in the language of the request.

ChargeSegment.doc: A stretch of time with one thing told by the automations.

fields.name: effect
fields.doc: null: nothing told yet.

ChargeDay.doc: A local day, midnight to midnight.

fields.name: day
fields.doc: "YYYY-MM-DD".

ChargeNext.doc: When the automations make it charge next (now, when they do).

ChargingView.doc: What a charger follows and does (`GET /api/devices/{id}/charging`).

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: What it was told.

fields.name: automation
fields.doc: The automation that told it (null: none yet, or by hand).

fields.name: own_schedule
fields.doc: Its own app decides when it charges: the automations do not apply.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: null: not looked at yet, or it follows nothing.

fields.name: days
fields.doc: What the automations plan over the next 3 days, from today.

fields.name: automations
fields.doc: The automations that drive it.
